title: THE KNIGHT’S DOUBLE THREAT
prompt: White to move. Can your knight attack the king and rook at once?
success: Great move! ★ Your knight checks the king and attacks the rook. You earned a star.
retry: A legal move. Try finding a square where the knight attacks both the king and the rook.

title: CHECKMATE IN ONE
prompt: White to move. Can your rook trap the black king in one move?
success: Checkmate! ★ The rook attacks the king, and your king guards every escape square.
retry: A legal move. Look for a rook move that checks the king on the edge of the board.

title: THE BISHOP’S PIN
prompt: White to move. Where can your bishop hold the black knight in place?
success: Pinned! ★ The knight cannot move without exposing its own king.
retry: A legal move. Try putting your bishop, the knight and the black king on one diagonal.

title: THE QUEEN’S DOUBLE ATTACK
prompt: White to move. Can your queen attack the king and the rook together?
success: Double attack! ★ The queen checks the king and also attacks the rook on a8.
retry: A legal move. Look for a queen move that points at the king and the rook at the same time.

title: SAVE YOUR KING
prompt: The black rook is checking your king. Can your bishop stop it?
success: Safe! ★ Your bishop captured the attacking rook.
retry: Sometimes the best defense is to capture the attacker. Try again.
